verdict.rationale: Postmark has a full documented inbound pipeline: configuring an inbound server/MX, domain forwarding, parsing emails (headers/body/attachments) into JSON, delivering to a webhook, retrying/bypassing blocked inbound messages, and IP allowlisting/security for the webhook endpoint. Node/TS docs even walk through Express route setup, payload validation, and idempotency for consuming inbound webhooks. Missing for 10: independent hands-on developer confirmation of the inbound webhook working end-to-end (community evidence found only covers outbound sending and an unrelated MCP incident).
